# SimWatch shortcuts

<!-- Generated by `python simwatch.py keys md` from HOTKEY_ACTIONS in simwatch.py + config.json `video.hotkeys`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Global shortcuts work while SimWatch's video rig runs, even when GSPro has focus. Press **Alt+H** for the on-screen map. Change any key in `config.json` -> `video.hotkeys` ("" disables one; a list such as `["Alt+H", "Alt+/"]` gives aliases).

## Replay

| Shortcut | What it does |
|---|---|
| `Alt+V` | Show the last swing replay now (DTL \| FO) |
| `Alt+K` | Keep the replay open; press again to close it |
| `Alt+X` | Close the replay / comparison and go back to GSPro |
| `Alt+A` | Auto replay after each shot: on / off |
| `Alt+L` | Show / hide the swing plane lines on the replay |
| `Alt+Shift+L` | Save the lines you dragged in Kinovea as the new default |

## Compare

| Shortcut | What it does |
|---|---|
| `Alt+M` | Match up with the reference: DTL you\|ref -> FO you\|ref -> back |

## Reference

| Shortcut | What it does |
|---|---|
| `Alt+R` | Next reference: My-Go-To -> each pro -> your previous swing |

## Session / Bookmark

| Shortcut | What it does |
|---|---|
| `Alt+G` | Save the last swing as your My-Go-To for this club |
| `Alt+C` | Record a swing now (manual camera trigger) |
| `Alt+O` | Open today's swing folder in Explorer |
| `Alt+D` | Open the drills hub |

## System

| Shortcut | What it does |
|---|---|
| `Alt+H` | Show / hide this shortcut map (auto-hides) |
| `Alt+S` | Show / hide ShotLab (opens it if closed) |
| `Alt+P` | Pin / unpin the OBS projector picture-in-picture |

## Notes

- Every plain `Alt+<key>` shortcut also works as `Ctrl+Alt+<key>` (registered as a fallback in case another program already owns the `Alt+<key>` combination).
- If a shortcut can't be registered (another program owns it), the startup log says so and suggests a free one; `python simwatch.py doctor` shows the registration status.
- The same list appears on screen (Alt+H), in `python simwatch.py keys`, in ShotLab's Keys pill and in the drills hub Shortcuts panel.
- Shortcuts use `Alt+<key>` because GSPro uses many single-letter keys. Avoid bare letters, F-keys without a modifier, `Ctrl+<letter>`, Alt+Enter (fullscreen toggle) and Alt+Tab/F4/Space/Esc.
